Zero occurrences of the token 158 remain in any of the six commands; every other leg of ac6 (README sha 8d141fb2, frozen-four workflows, three non-repaired pin greps, four-manifest rev-parse==hash-object via cmd.exe </dev/null, backend >=270+ruff+mypy>=83+head 005, frontend 0/0/0+>=187, tsc, exactly-4 lint, anchors tests[16]/tests[54] sha-pinned+green) is byte-identical.

measured_byte_pins.note: sha256(JSON.stringify(entry)) measured on MAIN @ 5ec4709 (index 163 entries); PROVEN STABLE across the t36 append: the same five hashes hold in the 158-entry groom-base blob b259674e (@ 5daaad1) and in the current 163-entry MAIN index - a full 158-entry entry-by-entry comparison of old-vs-new showed exactly ONE drifted entry (tests[5], the t0 security-paths exclusion, amended by t36 - not one of the five pinned entries). Pinning preferred over floor-only per task rule since stability was measured, not assumed.

evidence.floor_choice: 163 = current MAIN entry count at re-groom time (158 groom-base + 5 t36 entries). Floor is a lower bound: any future append-only growth (t37 and beyond) keeps ac4/ac6 green; any truncation below 163 or byte-drift of a pinned entry fails rc=1. The five pinned entries are append-immune by construction (appends cannot move indices < len).

FAIL-BEFORE-2 (new floor bites): corrected ac4 (file-extracted from committed card) on /tmp/trunc copy with index truncated to 162 entries -> rc=1, stderr index below 163-entry floor.
FAIL-BEFORE-3 (ac6 index legs): corrected ac6 ac4-harness chunk on truncated 162 -> rc=1 (index below 163-entry floor); corrected ac6 anchor-harness chunk on truncated 162 -> rc=1 (index below 163).
FAIL-BEFORE-4 (ac6 old leg): OLD ac6 anchor-harness leg on MAIN(163) -> rc=1, stderr index not 158 - proves the same conflict existed inside ac6 and the correction was required in both legs.
PASS-AFTER-1: corrected ac4 (file-extracted) on MAIN(163), frontend/node_modules populated via junction -> rc=0 (all five stored entries execSync green + all five byte-pins match).

PASS-AFTER-2: corrected ac6 executed in FOREGROUND CHUNKS (never detached): index-block a (corrected ac4 harness) rc=0; index-block b (anchor harness, anchors sha-pinned + both stored commands green) rc=0; backend-block (uv pytest collect >=270 + full suite + ruff + mypy >=83 + alembic single head 005) rc=0 under timeout 900; frontend-block (vitest json 0 failed/0 pending/0 todo + >=187 passed + tsc --noEmit + exactly-4 lint warnings) rc=0 under timeout 900.
